verses.raw: The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah,<sup foot_note=254058>1</sup> which they used to face?"<sup foot_note=254059>2</sup> Say, "To Allāh belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."
